hero.intro: A career moving across technology, enterprise systems and business analytics — from Infosys server rooms to NEOMA classrooms in France, now exploring how AI and automation turn data into practical business outcomes.
hero.creditsLine: starring Python · SQL · Tableau & n8n — from the enterprises of Infosys & the classrooms of NEOMA — directed by curiosity

aboutIntro: My career has never followed a completely straight line. I started with computer science and enterprise technology, moved into business analytics, explored product and data analytics, and became increasingly interested in artificial intelligence and automation. I moved from India to France for my M.Sc. at NEOMA — and that transition changed the way I approach technology: not only how systems work, but what the data means, what business problem it represents, and how technology can improve the outcome.

journey.title: Technology taught me how systems work.
body: At Infosys I worked with enterprise middleware environments, production systems, migrations, troubleshooting, SQL-based data operations and operational reporting.
I learned that behind every application or business process is a network of systems, dependencies, data, people and decisions.

journey.title: Analytics taught me to ask better questions.
body: During my M.Sc. in Business Analytics I developed stronger capabilities in SQL, Python, statistics, visualization, predictive analytics, business intelligence, data modeling and machine learning.
More importantly, I learned that analytics is not simply about producing a query or a dashboard. The real question is:
journey.highlight: What decision should this analysis help someone make?

journey.title: Product work taught me to connect data with people.
body: At the NEOMA Business School Incubator I worked with international students, analyzed user feedback, translated problems into product requirements, developed analytics frameworks, and contributed to an AI-powered onboarding solution.

journey.title: AI & automation are where I am exploring next.
body: I have been experimenting with workflows involving ChatGPT, Claude, n8n, LLM APIs, Ollama, Generative AI and Python automation.
My interest is not AI for the sake of AI — it is finding practical ways to reduce repetitive work, improve decision-making, and build better products and workflows.
journey.highlight: Find repetitive work → understand the workflow → automate → measure the result.

journey.title: The through-line — I am highly adaptable.
body: Every jump — a new country, a new language, a new domain — taught me something important about myself: I am highly adaptable.
New environment, unfamiliar tech stack, a role I have never done before — I find my footing fast, and I make it work.
journey.highlight: Give me a chance with any environment or technology, and I will figure it out.

philosophy.quote: Technology gives curiosity somewhere to go.
philosophy.body: I rarely want to learn something purely theoretically. If I want to understand a technology, I prefer to build something with it. I enjoy breaking complicated problems into smaller pieces, finding efficient ways to handle repetitive work, and turning an idea into something tangible.
